residue_source: designs scored against 6V8X chain A, the model they were built on; reference footprints against 6CM3 chain D, where they were measured
weighting: designs weighted by alanine-scan ddG; reference footprints weighted equally because no scan exists for them
limits: a matching residue at a contact position is necessary, not sufficient, and this is not a neutralization prediction; UniProt's env records are not a balanced sample of the epidemic

D5.null: contiguous surface patches of the same size, centred on a random exposed residue
